preconditions.description: The number of commands N is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(command) <= 100 for command in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command has a length between 1 and 100 characters.
Each command starts with an alphabetic character.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' in command for command in commands if command.startswith('Simon says'))
preconditions.description: If a command starts with 'Simon says', there is at least one space after 'says'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == command[11:] for output_line, command in zip(output_lines, commands) if command.startswith('Simon says'))
postconditions.description: For each command that starts with 'Simon says', the output line is the command without the first 11 characters ('Simon says ').

postconditions.expression: all(output_line not in output_lines for command in commands if not command.startswith('Simon says'))
postconditions.description: Commands that do not start with 'Simon says' are ignored and do not appear in the output.
